description: This Java source file defines the PreparedKamonTimer class, which is an implementation of the PreparedTimer interface utilizing Kamon metrics library for timing and metrics collection. It provides methods for creating, tagging, starting, recording, and retrieving metrics related to timers.

classes.name: PreparedKamonTimer
classes.description: A Kamon-based implementation of PreparedTimer, allowing creation and management of timing metrics with tags.

methods.name: newTimer
methods.description: Factory method to create a new PreparedKamonTimer instance with the given name.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Sets multiple tags on the timer.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific tag key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns a copy of all tags associated with this timer.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds a single tag to the timer.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer, returning a StartedTimer instance.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a specific measurement in the timer, converting the given time to nanoseconds.

methods.name: getTotalTime
methods.description: Returns the total accumulated time from the timer snapshot.

methods.name: getNumberOfRecords
methods.description: Returns the number of recorded measurements.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this timer.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Attempts to reset the timer snapshot, returns true if successful.
